findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

The men’s bathroom in the facility is without paper towels by the hand sink at the time of this inspection. Paper towels were supplied during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

A large hole is observed in the frame of the back door. This is remaining from the previous routine inspection conducted two years ago. Repairs the hole prior to the next routine inspection and maintain the facility in good repair moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The wall siding around the mop sink has been damaged and exposed wood/particle board. The PIC was shown and instructed to have repaired prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all areas subject to moisture are maintained sealed and smooth/easily cleanable.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

On arrival the mop is observed stored moist and with the head pooled up on the floor. The PIC was shown and instructed to store is so that the bristles are allowed to hang and air dry efficiently.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The walls around the mop sink in the back are observed with exposed wood/particle board. Reseal the walls. Paint was suggested.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Holes in the wall are observed in the back stock area and need to be repaired. Repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels available in the women's restroom. CORRECTED-- Paper towels provided, and must always be available for proper handwashing.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
--REPEAT #1: Soil residue observed in the bottoms of dairy coolers (both front and back of store).
--Significant frost build-up observed in the ice cream chest freezer. Clean non-food contact surfaces routinely to prevent soil accumulation.
4-601.11: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
Women's restroom door is not self-closing or tight-fitting. Adjust door and make repairs as needed so that the door is self-closing and tight-fitting.
6-202.14: Toilet rooms located on PREMISES shall be completely enclosed and provided with tightfitting and self-closing door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Three holes observed in the drywall separating the restrooms from the storage area near the back door. Repair holes.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Storage area is cluttered with backstock and shelving units to the point that is presumably difficult to maintain clean. Organize or discard unused items.
6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used.

Damp mop observed not stored properly. Prop mops so that they may airdry.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed that the thermometers in the cold holding units are either missing or on the back wall and not conspicuously placed. Provide proper thermometers to the cold holding units. 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed coolers holding milk to be soiled in the bottom and have dried splash on the insides. Observed that some shelves have food debris on them. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Floors throughout the facility are heavily soiled. Clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed several cans of products that were severly dented. The cans were removed from the shelves and put in a basket during the inspection to correct the violation.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors in the store to be soiled and soiled with debris. Clean floors in the store.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed that the mop was not hung up between uses to promote air-drying.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similiar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed  there were two cans of products that were severely dented: 1)apple filling, 2)pineapple chunks. All other canned products on shelves were checked, and only minor denting was observed on any other product on display. 
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.
Remove any canned products that have been dented along the top, bottom, or vertical seams.
CORRECTED= Cans were segregated and placed into Damaged Product container in store room.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed that the mop sink was soiled and the drain was blocked with old mop heads and other debris.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
Clean the mop sink area.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed that the waste receptacles in the rest rooms did not have lids.  
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.
Provide lids for waste receptacles in rest rooms.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed that the floors in the store room and in the rest rooms were soiled.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.
Clean the floors in the above areas.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed that there are several holes in the drywall in the store room caused by the push-carts that are used to move merchandise around the store.
Also observed that there is a ceiling tile missing in the men's rest room.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
Repair the above-referenced areas.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed that the mop was not hung up between uses to promote air-drying.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
Store the mop upright so as to promote air-drying between uses.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
(A) The mop sink was soiled.
(B) The drain cover in the mop sink was missing.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
Clean the mop sink and replace the drain cover to it.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
(A) Both bathrooms had wastebaskets with no covers.
(B) There were no paper towels in the women's bathroom.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.
Provide covered wastebaskets in both bathrooms and put paper towels at the sink in the women's bathroom.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The following floors were soiled:   (A) Both bathrooms, especially around the stools, sinks, and urinal.     (B) In front of the emergency exit door near the bathrooms,     (C) Near the mop sink and water heater (whole hallway floor in this area),     (D) Outside employee break room,    (E) Generally the entire back storeroom floor.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. 
Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
(1) There are damaged walls in the following locations:  (A) In front of the emergency exit near the bathrooms,    (B) Between the bathroom doors,    (C) In the store room near the doorway to the store (doorway nearest the bathrooms).
(2) A ceiling tile was missing in the men's restroom and a tile was bowed down and not fitting in the ceiling grid in the women's restroom.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.
Repair the damaged walls and replace any missing or damaged ceiling tiles in the restrooms.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
A mop was stored in a bucket of mop water.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a sanitary manner.
Store the mop so that it can be air dried after it has been cleaned.  Also, empty the dirty water in the mop bucket.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.citation_text: 750.130 - Raw bacon & country sausage were stored above & next to fully cooked bacon & hot dogs. Store raw foods below ready to eat foods. Raw bacon & sausage were moved to the bottom shelf w/ shell eggs.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.citation_text: 750.1050 - Mop was observed sitting in mop bucket full of extremely filthy waste water (blackish brown color). Empty mop buckets when the water gets dirty & refill w/ clean water. Mop water was emptied. **Dirty mop water provides water source for pests.**

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.citation_text: 750.1390 - Mop was observed sitting in mop bucket full of extremely filthy waste water (blackish brown color). Store mops hanging or inverted between uses. Dirty mop head was discarded.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 - Mopsink was clogged & filthy and cover to drain of mopsink was off. Mopsink was unclogged during the inspection. Clean the mopsink & replace the missing cover.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Front doors had gaps where light was visible on the bottom & sides. Repair the front doors so they are tight fitting & light is not visible.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor along walls by mopsink was soiled w/ dead bugs (ants & a beetle). Clean the floor around the mopsink.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1110d & 1120e - A) both restrooms had uncovered waste cans. Provide lids for waste cans or replace w/ ne covered waste cans. B) Women’s' room did not have soap & men's room dispenser was almost out. Provide soap for restrooms & always maintain soap & paper towels at handsinks.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - Ceiling tiles in both restrooms are absorbent/acoustic. Replace w/ smooth/easily cleanable tiles at the next remodel.

findings.title: Clean and soiled linen segregated and properly stored.
findings.citation_text:
750.1380 - Dirty wiping cloths were observed on mopsink ledge. Store dirty wiping cloths in nonabsorbent containers or washable laundry bag until removed from premises to be laundered. Rags were discarded.
**Use disposable paper towels s/ spray bottles of cleaner. Otherwise, have a container of sanitizer solution w/ wiping sloths in the container between uses. Always properly label chemicals/containers of sanitizer solution (if used).**
